summary: In the Event streams mapping form choose the Rulebook source (unnamed sources show as __SOURCE_1 etc.) and the event stream, then Save; the source becomes an ansible.eda.pg_listener type, replacing webhook-compatible sources' type, name and arguments while filters, rules, conditions and actions are unchanged.
questions: What is __SOURCE_1 in the event stream mapping?
Which rulebook sources can an event stream replace?
Does replacing a source with an event stream change my rules?
